title: gymnanthemum anceps
intro: Gymnanthemum anceps, commonly known as Elephantopus, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Gymnanthemum anceps include antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
